# SQLite 3.54.0 Storage Diagnostics Fixtures

These databases were generated by the pinned SQLite 3.54.0 shell at Fossil
check-in
`65ec11f05a9ee5b23495427ece76c0550a8ffc28980a8a0c72d556ba0d2290e2`.
Both use 512-byte pages and pass `PRAGMA integrity_check`.

## `sqlite-3.54.0-storage.db`

```sql
PRAGMA page_size=512;
PRAGMA auto_vacuum=NONE;
VACUUM;
CREATE TABLE alpha(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO alpha VALUES(2, 'two');
INSERT INTO alpha VALUES(4, printf('%.*c', 900, 'x'));
INSERT INTO alpha VALUES(6, 'six');
CREATE INDEX alpha_value ON alpha(value);
CREATE TABLE wr(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER) WITHOUT ROWID;
INSERT INTO wr VALUES('a', 10), ('b', 20);
CREATE VIEW alpha_view AS SELECT id, value FROM alpha;
CREATE TRIGGER alpha_trigger
AFTER INSERT ON alpha BEGIN SELECT new.id; END;
CREATE TABLE discarded(payload BLOB);
INSERT INTO discarded VALUES(zeroblob(2200));
DROP TABLE discarded;
```

The database has 14 pages and six freelist pages. Schema roots are:

| Object | Type | Root page |
|---|---|---:|
| `alpha` | table | 2 |
| `alpha_value` | index | 4 |
| `wr` | table with index storage | 7 |
| `alpha_view` | view | 0 |
| `alpha_trigger` | trigger | 0 |

It covers schema root discovery, table and index storage, WITHOUT ROWID
storage, zero-root schema objects, local and overflow records, and freelist
traversal.

## `sqlite-3.54.0-storage-autovacuum.db`

```sql
PRAGMA page_size=512;
PRAGMA auto_vacuum=INCREMENTAL;
VACUUM;
CREATE TABLE auto_sample(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT);
INSERT INTO auto_sample VALUES(3, printf('%.*c', 1100, 'm'));
INSERT INTO auto_sample VALUES(7, 'seven');
CREATE INDEX auto_payload ON auto_sample(payload);
CREATE TABLE auto_free(payload BLOB);
INSERT INTO auto_free VALUES(zeroblob(1800));
DROP TABLE auto_free;
```

The database has 12 pages, four freelist pages, and a pointer-map page at page
2. Schema roots are table page 3 and index page 4. It covers root, child,
overflow, and free pointer-map entries.
